ablation_history.result: REJECTED — single-perceptron global tuning with 50 positives + 150 random negatives caused ALL axes to drop to P@10=0%. Random negatives don't represent the audit's ranking task (which compares the entire candidate set, not GT-vs-random). The ablation's suggested rebalance (x3_chemical 2.5 → -1.17, x8_compound_diversity 1.2 → -2.20) trashed cross-aroma (was passing at 40%) without lifting the 3 failing axes. Per-axis weight tuning would be a better architecture but is out of scope here.
